name: Translation Studies
description: Promotes the interdisciplinary study of translation and facilitates translation practices encompassing literary, social, political, economic, legal, technological, and medical dimensions.
notes: No more than three of the five courses may originate in the same department.

Each student must attend three lectures or events listed through the Translation Initiative and submit a brief written response for each. Other translation activities may count at the director's discretion.
No course taken Credit/D/Fail may be applied toward the certificate.
No more than two course credits may overlap with a major, simultaneous degree, or another certificate.
No course credit may be applied toward the requirements of more than two curricular programs.
Approved graduate and professional school courses may count toward the certificate.
Courses taken at another institution or during an approved summer or term-time study abroad program may count with DUS approval.
Declare on Yale Hub by January 15 or September 15 of the final semester at the latest.

nonCourseRequirements: Attend three lectures or events listed through the Translation Initiative and submit a brief written response to each to the certificate director
policy.sourceNote: Of the five credits, no more than three may originate in the same department. No more than two course credits may overlap in the fulfillment of the requirements of the Translation Studies certificate or of a major, a simultaneous degree, or another certificate.

requirements.name: Translation-themed courses
requirements.description: Five course credits on translation-themed topics from the approved course list posted each semester on the Translation Studies Initiative website. No more than three may originate in the same department.
